title: Humanization Law
summary: Every external output passes brand-voice check. Em-dashes, AI cliches = block.

title: Completion Audit Binding
summary: Goals close only when audit passes.

title: Hive Log Everything
summary: No silent work. If not in hive, it did not happen.

title: Priority Discipline
summary: Critical and high are rare. Melanie has veto on priority inflation.

title: Delegation Visible
summary: goal delegate agent always. No invisible handoffs.

title: Zero Revenue Leakage
summary: Every output tracked against billable line in CRM. No unbilled work.

title: PDF-First Document Delivery
summary: All viewable documents for Jason or clients produced as PDF by default. Word only when specifically requested.

title: Cron Never Interrupts Active Work
summary: Cron notifications acknowledged and scheduled, never interrupt active task. Current task always top priority.

title: Document Quality Gate
summary: Before sending any document to Jason or client, producing agent verifies entire document for errors end-to-end.

title: GHL Retirement
summary: GoHighLevel RETIRED. Not suspended, not pending reconnect, no resume condition. No agent may reference as active, flag disconnection as gap, recommend reconnecting, or include in any scorecard/audit/capability assessment. Disposition class D003.

title: Per-Action .claude/ Writes
summary: All writes to .claude/ directory require per-action authorization. H8 finding, first-week gate.

title: Registry Writes Via Bash Only
summary: All writes to governed surfaces use bash-only commands. Edit/Write tool calls bypass gate.

title: Verified Never Self-Reported
summary: Evidence collection uses verified sources only. No self-reported data accepted as proof.

title: Session Authority Boundaries
summary: All sessions, autonomous or interactive, absent explicit in-session approval from Jason, may not write constitutional surfaces, create scheduled automation, or assert vendor/architecture decisions without ratified directive pointer.

title: MagicLight.ai Time Break Designation
summary: MagicLight.ai designated primary tool for Time Break channel visuals. Lived-fact provenance confirmed by Jason. C6 flag ratified.

title: Neo Engineering Chamber AGENTS.md Update
summary: Authorized append of Neo Engineering Chamber governance block to AGENTS.md. Context file reading order, invariants enforcement, Three-Prompt Workflow mandate, and Engineering Chamber role roster.
